info.name: NomadTracks
info.summary: View your synced NomadTracks library on a map
info.description:
Browse the library that the NomadTracks mobile app (iOS / Android) syncs into the `NomadTracks/` folder of your Nextcloud files.
- Folder tree of your Tracks, POIs, Maps and Routes - Each track has a checkbox: tick it to draw that track on the map (the map starts empty of tracks, like the app's "Show on Map" toggle) - POIs (GeoJSON) are placed as markers when the page loads - A details pane shows the selected track's stats and an elevation profile, computed with the same elevation filter the mobile app uses - Standard / Terrain map type switcher and a direction-of-travel arrows toggle, remembered per browser - Which tracks and POIs are shown is saved per user, so the same selection comes back on every device; folders have a select-all box - A summary of all shown tracks (distance, time, elevation, categories) - Add-ons for special purposes, reached from a small menu in that summary; the first one exports the selection as an Austrian practice-driving logbook (Fahrtenprotokoll gemäß § 19 Abs. 8 FSG) — printable / PDF and CSV - "Open in NomadTracks" for GPX files in the Files app - Track colors come from the `.nomadmeta.json` sidecars written by the app - Routes (`.nomadroute` packages) are drawn from the GPX embedded in the package - Custom map packages (`.nomadmap`) are listed but not rendered
This app is read-only: it never modifies the synced files. It requires the NomadTracks mobile app to have synced a library to this Nextcloud account. The base map is loaded from map.nomadtracks.app.
